svg.text: v27 full: actual warm-loop fetch / issue / retirement
pre = before rising edge; post = after edge. PCs/data apply only while their valid signal is 1.
f_size=3: 8 bytes per request. wide_take_count=2: two ordered packets accepted in one edge.
pair_fire=1 dispatches two independent ALUs; commit_valid + commit2_valid retire two instructions in order.
